notes.title: New Game Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings survivors![/b]
Today I am excited to announce my next game project: [b]Explosive Odds[/b]! In Explosive Odds you will be taking turns between 2-4 players cutting wires on the BombSlot device. Earn money, use abilities to gain an edge over chance and don't go boom! It has been a lot of fun working on this game so far and I am excited for you all to get your hands on it in the future. In the meantime be sure to wishlist the game and join the discord to follow its development. (This game will be sharing the Betrayal Beach discord which is now the Pig Bot Games discord: https://discord.gg/y7guXuWJqP). 
This game is developed under my new studio Pig Bot Games. For this project I have brought on an artist to the team so Explosive Odds will have all original style and flair.
As always thank you for the continues support, I hope you will check out the new game!

notes.title: The Mountain DLC Update 1.7.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.7.0 The Mountain![/h1]
Greetings Survivors!
[b]This update brings a new DLC with an all new map, The Mountain! Complete with 4 forage locations, 20+ new cards and an all new unique warmth system.[/b] Priced at 5.99 USD, this map is meant to be a harder survival experience, so working together and communicating is key! I had a lot of fun making this DLC, and I hope you enjoy playing it. As with the Island Curse DLC only the host needs to own The Mountain to play on it. However, the DLC does also include 3 new skins to use, and you will need to own it to use them.

[h3]Final Update and Thank You:[/h3]
[b]I would also like to say a big thank you to everyone who has played the game thus far.[/b] (And thanks for 200 steam reviews!). Working on this game has been a lot of fun and it has been super cool to see people play, leave reviews, make videos, and join in community play events. The game reached a lot more people than I thought it would with just over 40,000 lifetime unique users and hundreds of thousands of views on YouTube. So again thank you <3. That all being said, this will be the last major update for Betrayal Beach. (There may be a few more smaller patches with fixes and tweaks though). I originally only intended to work on it for another 2 months after release but 7 months later here we are. But stay tuned! I'm in the early prototyping phase of my next project and will be announcing it here when It's ready.

There is also now a steam bundle including all 3 DLC for 10% off! Tip for steam bundles: if you already own the other two DLC then buying the bundle will just apply the 10% discount to The Mountain DLC.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48567/Betrayal_Beach_Complete/

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[b]The Mountain Map[/b]
[list]
[*] Has 4 forage locations: The Cave, Mountainside, Valley and Lake.
[*] New resource Clay. Similar to plants, stone and wood. Used for night events and some crafting.
[*] New resource Kindling. Used for restoring warmth at the campfire.
[*] More new unique cards waiting to be discovered.
[*] New cards, craftables, events, hazards and more!
[*] 3 new skins.
[*] 2 new achievements.
[/list]
[b]Warmth[/b]
[list]
[*] Only on The Mountain Map
[*] Various hazards, night events, or failing to add kindling to the new fire may reduce your warmth.
[*] Lower warmth will reduce your maximum health, freezing over up to 3 slots.
[*] Raising your warmth back up via adding kindling to the fire or a few special cards will return your max health.
[*] When a health slot is frozen if it was full that health will be stored, and can be restored once warmth returns.
[/list]
[b]Misc Other[/b]
[list]
[*] New map tab in game settings used to change what map will be played on.
[*] New 'Useful' card tag, this will count as any resource when added to the stockpile.
[*] Survivor ghosts will now get a 'Useful' card instead of 1 of each resource.
[*] New guidebook page on warmth.
[*] Tabs to quickly swap to rules or roles in guidebook.
[*] Various tweaks, fixes and small details.
[/list]

notes.title: New Roles + More! 1.6.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.6.0 New Roles + More![/h1]
Greetings Survivors!
This update brings two new roles: the Politician (Base Game) and the Killer (Island's Curse DLC). In addition it brings a few new match settings to play with and a few misc. tweaks and fixes. Hope you enjoy the new content!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Roles
[list]
[*] Politician: (Survivor) Their vote counts for 2 in both stages of exile vote.
[*] Killer: (Saboteur) May use their ability to get a new Blowgun card. This card can be played on another player to kill them. When played it will reveal the killer with red smoke particle effects that last a few seconds. So make sure no one spots you!
[*] New roles have achievements and cosmetics.
[/list]
[*] New Game Settings
[list]
[*] Lockbox may spawn toggle. Turns on or off the Lockbox with the Biometric scanner and medkit.
[*] Gun Case may spawn toggle. Turns on or off the new Gun Case object. Works similarly to the lockbox but inside is a Gun card (same as Marshal ability) when 5 or more players are alive, or a Small Gun with less. The Small Gun is similar to the normal Gun card but does only 1 damage instead of 4.
[*] Ritual Site may spawn toggle. Turns on or off the new Ritual Site object. Has a low chance to spawn starting from the second day. Saboteurs may spend 1 suffering point to activate the Ritual Site. Once Activated the Saboteur shrine will gain 1 extra level that night.
[/list]
[*] Other Tweaks and Fixes
[list]
[*] Role cards from abilities can no longer be lost to hazards. (No more squirrels stealing your crowbar!)
[*] Fixed a bug causing Limited Time Objects (Cache, Lockbox etc.) to stay around longer than they should.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Expanded Game Rule Settigns 1.5.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.5.0 Expanded Game Rule Settings[/h1]
Greetings Survivors!
This update brings an overhaul to the game rules menu. Improved UI, saving presets, and various new rules to further customize your experience. The goal of this update was to give players more control over their games and introduce more replayability with some more interesting and unique rule options. More rules will come in the future as well. Have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706650/375c2d450bb95659a607a746d24eeb1261eac344.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Overhauled Game Settings UI.[/b]
[list]
[*] Larger menu so options aren't so cluttered.
[*] Settings organized into categories for easier navigation.
[/list]
[*] [b]Game Rule Presets.[/b]
[list]
[*] Save current rules selection as a named preset.
[*] Load from all saved rule presets to immediately apply settings.
[/list]
[*] [b]New Game Rules.[/b]
[list]
[*] Toggle on or off ghost abilities.
[*] Set starting health and hunger values.
[*] Hide trial vote numbers toggle.
[*] Express voting (The player with the most votes after the first vote stage dies).
[*] Customizable role amounts (Can now have more than 1 of each role!).
[*] Event difficulty mod (Increase how many resources are needed for night event).
[*] Days to win can now be set to never.
[*] Adjust role ability cooldowns.
[*] Leader role exclusive vote stages (First, second, or both).
[/list]
[*] [b]Misc Other.[/b]
[list]
[*] Engineer totem / cache prevention now won't take the Saboteur's suffering points.
[*] Various other UI tweaks.
[*] A few fixes.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Island's Curse DLC Update 1.4.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.4.0 Island's Curse Update[/h1]
Greetings Survivors!
Version 1.4.0 brings the Island's Curse DLC among several tweaks and fixes. The DLC is now available for 4.99$ and comes with 7 roles and 9 player skins. To use the new DLC roles in game the host must own the DLC. Only the host needs to own it, so other players can enjoy the new roles without having to purchase it as well. Now onto the patch notes.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Island's Curse.[/b]
[list]
[*] Includes 9 new player skins.
[*] Includes the following 7 roles:
[*] Engineer (Survivor) - Gets a 'Frequency Blocker' card that can be played on totems or caches to prevent saboteurs from using them.
[*] Investigator (Survivor) - Gain a 'Hidden Camera' card that can be played on another player to be notified each time they move to a new location.
[*] Leader (Survivor) - When the Leader is in the game they are publicly marked and are the only player who is allowed to vote for exile.
[*] Cursed (Survivor) - When the Cursed player dies the Saboteur shrine will be set to max level that night instead of resetting to first.
[*] Cannibal (Saboteur) - The Cannibal won't gain any benefit from normal food or healing cards. Each day they may use a 'Bite' card to steal a hunger from another player. Additionally whenever a player dies they will get a 'Flesh' card that they can eat or use to poison the campfire.
[*] Trapper (Saboteur) - Gets a 'Trap' card which may be played at a forage location to trap it. The next player to forage there will be hit with the trap and take a point of damage.
[*] Omen (Saboteur) - Gain a 'Ritual Bones' card which can be played at a forage location to make it treacherous the next day. While treacherous that location's danger level will increase much faster with each forage.
[*] Each new achievement has an associated 'Win' achievement that awards a new seat decoration. You do not need to own the DLC to earn these achievements.
[/list]
[*] [b]Hotkeys![/b]
[list]
[*] Hotkeys for each tab button. (J - Event), (M - Map), (K - Craft), (L - Exile), (N - Notebook), (H - Guidebook).
[*] Hotkeys for emotes. (1-6).
[/list]
[*] [b]Miscellaneous.[/b]
[list]
[*] Rulebook role entries now give a summary of the roles ability.
[*] Can now mark names with specific role icons in the notebook.
[*] Role ability button UI made a little more clear and has a '?' button that can be hovered to see ability description and cooldown.
[*] Notifications sent in text chat now play a distinct sound.
[*] Skin entries in customize menu now have different color borders based on DLC required.
[*] Notification icon is displayed after earning a new seat cosmetic.
[*] End game dead and die to hazard seat material cosmetics changed (they were too similar).
[*] Guidebook tab no longer minimizes at night.
[*] Fixed all 'Win' achievements not actually requiring you to win the game.
[*] Fixed the way roles were picked making it so 'Guaranteed' roles weren't always guaranteed.
[*] Various other small tweaks and fixes.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Role Design Contest!
notes.notes:
Greetings Survivors , I am here to announce:
[b]The Role Design Contest![/b]
Have an idea for an in game role you think would be cool? Submit your idea for a chance to have it adapted into the game! Plus get a steam key for the supporter pack and upcoming roles DLC if your idea is chosen.

This contest is being held in the game's [url=https://discord.gg/y7guXuWJqP]Discord[/url]! (so join to participate :) )

Rules are as follows:

- Make a post in #feedback-or-ideas in the discord [b]Before August 23rd[/b]   
     - Give your post the ‘Role’ tag
     - In your post write out your idea for an in game role
     - Example roles can be seen in game (tracker, marshal, trickster ETC)
     - Be as detailed as possible
     - Also include what team this role is for (Survivors, Saboteurs, or maybe both?)
- If you have multiple role ideas include them all in the same post
     - [i]Please limit yourself to less than 4 ideas.[/i] (1 idea is preferred).
- After August 23rd I will pick one role idea to be adapted into the game to be included in the upcoming role DLC.
     - The winning role idea will get a steam key for the supporter pack and role DLC.
     - A few runner up ideas will also get a key for one DLC of their choice.

Role idea guidelines: (you don’t have to follow these, but it's best if you do)
- Roles should not include a new win condition or a new team
- Try to make the roles work with the in game systems (For example use of the ability button, and cards)
- If you are feeling stuck or want to refine your idea, feel free to use the already existing roles for inspiration. You may also want to look to other existing mechanics for possible role abilities.
- Have fun!

notes.title: 7-8 Player Update Version 1.3.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.3.0 The 7-8 Player Update[/h1]
Greetings Survivors!
The Island is getting a little more crowded with support for up to 8 players in a match. Experience the chaos of arguing about who took the food with 7 other people! This update also includes Steam achievements. And the feature everyone has been waiting for... rock customization! You can now customize your seat with new styles and decorations. These cosmetics start locked but can all be earned through achievements. There is more in this update as well, so be sure to check out the full patch notes below. Thank you for all the continued support, I hope you enjoy the update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706650/928bf91ebe6fa2ac5c5727bdc0e420151e16040b.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]7-8 Player Support![/b]
[list]
[*] You can now make lobbies with up to 8 players.
[*] Some locations and UI elements have been tweaked to fit more players.
[/list]
[*] [b]Achievements and Seat Cosmetics.[/b]
[list]
[*] 16 steam achievements have been added.
[*] All seat cosmetics are locked. They can be earned through Achievements!
[*] Two types of seat cosmetic: Styles and Decorations.
[*] Seat cosmetics can be set in a new tab in the customize menu.
[/list]
[*] [b]Ghost Tweaks.[/b]
[list]
[*] Living players can no longer see dead player ghosts.
[*] New game setting that lets living players see ghosts. (In case you preferred the way it was).
[*] Players will now ragdoll whenever and wherever they die.
[/list]
[*] [b]Clients Now See Game Settings.[/b]
[list]
[*] All clients can open the game settings book in the lobby and see what rules have been set.
[/list]
[*] [b]Misc. other tweaks, changes, and fixes.[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved voice reconnection button function.
[*] Various UI and location tweaks.
[*] Changed into ticket sprite from orange to teal.
[*] Volcano exile now hides player and UI when ragdoll is thrown.
[*] All roles now start as won't appear in game settings.
[*] Lockbox will now disappear the day it is opened.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: 7-8 Player Update Beta!
notes.notes:
[b]Attention Survivors![/b]
[u]The 7-8 player update is now available for testing on the public beta branch![/u]
New features include support for up to 8 players in a lobby and seat cosmetics. (All seat cosmetics are unlocked in the beta but will be unlocked through achievements upon the updates release). If you participate in the beta please leave feedback in the games discord!

How to activate the beta (all players in group must be on the beta version to play together): 
1. Right click the game in your steam library and select properties.
2. Select the betas tab
3. In the beta participation dropdown list select 'publictesting - Public Testing Branch'
4. The game should update and now be in the beta. The version in game should be B1.3.X.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706650/928bf91ebe6fa2ac5c5727bdc0e420151e16040b.png[/img]

notes.title: Roles Update Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.2.0 The Roles Update[/h1]
Greetings Survivors ! Betray your friends in all new ways in the new Roles Update!
This update includes 5 new roles (3 for Survivors, 2 for Saboteurs). Each role has their own new abilities to mix up gameplay in new and interesting ways. You can control which roles appear and how often in the game settings. Detailed patch notes below, have fun and thank you all for the continued support!

Oh, and the DLC with more roles and cosmetics is still in the works and will be releasing in a couple weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706650/2bcd631499124aef8befc7d4db5cbb7cec3116f5.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Saboteur ability: See how many players are at each location on your map.
[*] 5 Roles:
[list]
[*] Survivor, Tracker: See how many players are at each location on your map.
[*] Survivor, Thief: Use your ability (3 day cooldown) to get a crowbar, which can be used to open saboteur caches.
[*] Survivor, Marshal: After day 4, use your ability to get a gun, which can be used to kill any player.
[*] Saboteur, Shade: Use your ability (3 day cooldown) to turn yourself and all other players into dark spirits. A Dark Spirit's identity is hidden, and they cannot speak. Useable only during the morning, effect lasts one phase.
[*]  Saboteur, Trickster: Use your ability (2 day cd) to get one of three cards. A snake that will poison food in the campfire and add 2 portions. Tar, which when added to the stockpile, will hide the contributor list. And a card that will turn a single player into a Dark Spirit for the phase.
[/list]
[*] Updated game rules for roles
[list]
[*] Each role has 4 levels that can be set.
[*] Wont show.
[*] Uncommon (30% chance to appear).
[*] Common (70% chance to appear).
[*] Guaranteed.
[/list]
[*] Updated Intro
[list]
[*] New UI that shows team and role.
[*] New visuals for Saboteurs.
[/list]
[*] Updated UI
[list]
[*] Overhauled Crafting UI.
[*] New UI for roles.
[*] Updated discard button and hand count.
[/list]
[*] Local voice volume adjustment for all players in lobby.
[*] Poisoned food rework: When eaten, will now give a random health / hunger value in a range.
[*] Various other fixes, tweaks and changes.
[list]
[*] Food no longer stays in campfire overnight.
[*] Saboteur Cache spawn chance increase
[*] Hand full popup now closes on phase change.
[*] Guidebook page for new roles.
[*] Name will be properly updated in voice popups.
[*] Can no longer join lobbies with a different game version. (And they wont appear in the lobby list).
[*] And more!
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Content Roadmap and Discord!
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

It has been 1 full week since the game launched and I have some big news. First and foremost is the launch of the official Discord server! Join the server to suggest features, report bugs, find groups to play with, or just keep up with development.

[url=https://discord.gg/y7guXuWJqP][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706650/4ea34895ba3a6bc35987956bcce726c7bfeacd49.png[/img][/url]

Next are the results of the content poll. After 69 votes, the breakdown was as follows.
Dead player content: 37.7% (26 Votes)
Unique Roles: 31.9% (22 Votes)
7-8 Player support: 30.4% (21 Votes)
The votes were super close, but now that they are in I present to you the new content roadmap!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706650/259a816e013970df9ab096ad4d9fafdf7f0f296e.png[/img]

notes.title: Betrayal Beach Game Overview
notes.notes:
Below is a more detailed summary of how Betrayal Beach is played! Note that the game is still in early development. Some gameplay elements are subject to change, and more content and features will be added.

When the game starts, players are put into one of two teams: Survivors or Saboteurs.

[b]Survivors (3~6):[/b] After their plane crash landed just off shore, survivors must work together to live long enough for rescue to come. Ward off starvation, avoid the hazards of the island, and work together to prevent catastrophic events. The survivors’ goal is to live through a number of days until rescue comes. 

[b]Saboteurs (1~2):[/b] Servants of the island, the saboteur's job is to make sure no survivors make it off the island and that any time they do spend on the island is full of suffering. Lie, deceive, and sabotage to achieve your goal.

Each game takes place over a series of days, and each day is split into multiple phases. Morning, Afternoon, Evening, and Night.

[h2]Morning[/h2]
The Morning is the longest phase. The new daily night event is revealed and players have the opportunity to traverse the island in search of resources. During this phase, players may choose an island location to go to: Beach, Forest, or Plateau. Each of which has its own resource loot pools.

[b]Night Events:[/b]
Each day, players face a new peril in the form of night events. Night events detail negative effects that will happen at the end of each day if the players do not work together to prevent them. These events can be stopped by collecting enough of the required resources, so be on the lookout for them in the next phase!

[b]Forage:[/b]
Different resource cards can be found at each location by foraging. When foraging, the player will be dealt three cards and can choose one to take. Whether you need resources to prevent the night event, food to ward off starvation, or the last piece to craft a useful item, what you take here is up to you. 

[b]Hazards:[/b]
Players are able to forage as many times as they want to get the resources they need. However, the more a player does, the higher the risk they put themselves in. Each time you forage, your danger level increases. The higher your danger level, the more likely you are to run into hazards. These hazards have a variety of negative effects, all of which will hinder your progress in some way.

[b]Craft:[/b]
Various helpful items can be crafted with foraged resource cards. Examples include weapons such as a spear or dagger that may prevent hazards. Or a basket that allows for increased card carrying capacity.

[h2]Afternoon[/h2]
During the afternoon phase, players meet back up at camp to pool their resources to stop the night event and cook the raw food they have gathered.

[b]The Campfire:[/b]
While foraging, players may collect raw food, which can only be eaten once cooked in the campfire. The campfire is a communal resource, meaning any player may contribute raw food in the afternoon and take out cooked food in the evening. Communicating with your fellow survivors to see who should get how much food is important if you want to increase your odds of survival. If a player goes into the night phase hungry enough, they will starve and take damage.

[b]The Stockpile:[/b]
In order to prevent the consequences of the night event, players must contribute cards to the stockpile. Any card may be added to the stockpile by any player. If enough of the required cards are added to the stockpile, the night event consequences will be prevented. However, each added card that was not required by the night event will count against the correct resources added. So it's possible for players to sabotage the stockpile by adding incorrect cards! All contributions to the stockpile are anonymous, and the results of night event prevention are shown in the next phase.

[h2]Evening[/h2]
During the evening phase, players will find out the results of the stockpile, may take cooked food from the fire, and vote to exile players.

[b]Exiling:[/b]
Any player may call for an exile vote, then all players will get to vote on who they wish to exile, if anyone. Once all players have submitted their votes, the results are tallied, and the player who received the most votes is exiled from camp. Once exiled from camp, the player succumbs to the horrors of the dark and dies. Exiling players is a great way to get rid of the saboteurs. However, if done wrong, it can lead to innocent survivors being killed.

[h2]Night[/h2]
The night phase is rather brief. For the survivors, the night phase summarizes the results of the night event and enacts any negative consequences if it was not prevented. Saboteurs are unaffected by the consequences of night events, and during this phase are able to choose the next day’s night event from three available possibilities.
